speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: After extensive consultations, the Cabinet has selected the offshore location in the Conan Sea for the wind park.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: The location offers strong wind conditions and is considered suitable for meeting Arcadia's renewable energy targets.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: The decision has been made. The wind park will be constructed at this location.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: Your task is to oversee the project and respond to the consequences that arise once construction begins.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: The Conan Sea is already heavily used by fishing communities, shipping interests and marine ecosystems.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: The wind park will therefore affect several stakeholders in different ways.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: You will need to monitor these impacts and determine which measures Arcadia should take to reduce them.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: Your decisions will affect biodiversity, trade, employment, food production and climate policy.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: You must also ensure that Arcadia continues to meet its obligations under international law.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: The construction team is ready. The wind park will now be built at the selected location.
